text: Vendored gittoc resynced to upstream v0.9.0

Vendored copy at v0.9.0 (upstream 0ad3b5a); upstream's own test suite passes against the vendored copy (run with the server venv's pytest); git toc fsck clean; no migration of the gittoc branch needed.

Upstream's test suite against the vendored copy: 184 passed, 2 failed — both TestSetupScript cases assert that AGENTS.md exists in the tree, which the vendored copy leaves out on purpose; the setup script's refusal and its message pass. No fix needed.
